'''Zeak''' was a [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was part of Imperial strike team during the events of the [[Conquest of Makeb]] acting as an underworld trading expert.<ref name="Rise of the Hutt Cartel" />
